title: Blue Moon Chasers, Sonny Clapp, and T Holder of the Clouds of Joy
summary: Albert on the Blue Moon Chasers and Bud Johnson, trombonist Sonny Clapp, and trumpeter T Holder who led the original Clouds of Joy.
